digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Ubuntu runner efficiency
propositions: Ubuntu default-tier cells occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run (py3.11=615s, py3.12=634s, py3.13=563s baseline) while bridge-cadence test reads and parses workflow YAML 1,440 times redundantly instead of once, contributing 100-130s per cell and eliminating only 0.00106s of real checking

render_unit existential assertion exhaustively invokes real Pandoc 232 times to assert only cardinality witnesses (>0 count), shortcircuitable in 0.035s with 1 subprocess, and both invariants preserved under identity-renderer mutation

test_wiki_render_hardening.py runs both current _convert and duplicated _legacy_convert against all 884 units (3,421 total Pandoc invocations), with process startup dominating 45.60s wall and legacy oracle provably decoupled from live product by immutable fixture substitution

editor-loopback fixture setup consumes 35-51s across Ubuntu/macOS cells attributed to socket.getfqdn recursion and TCPServer.server_bind traversal, measurable with nested instrumentation but unresolved by tmp_path sibling scanning or transient starvation

Static complexity-lock policy evaluation occupies 52-55s in every Ubuntu cell redundantly when identical OS/Python-invariant checks could run once in lint job, and scheduler admission/final-vote orchestration adds 60-150s to end-to-end wall after macOS execution completes

Pre-6f412 workflow job-level always() predicates prevent cancellation of superseded same-change patchset runs, forcing 25-minute concurrent-slot blocking until predecessor terminates naturally and causing 57m/50m wall-time outliers, resolvable by cancellation-aware status check
